0022600152.text: The San Antonio Spurs (3-2, riding a three-game win streak, 4th in the Southwest and 8th in the West) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (4-2, on a one-game win streak, 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though Minnesota took the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 and the Spurs won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-2, most recently a 139-109 win in Minneapolis on May 15. The Spurs are missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Stephon Castle is day-to-day with a mild head injury and is a game-time decision, while the Timberwolves are without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) and Rudy Gobert (back spasms).
